thread:
michaela: Quick follow-up after the policy sync. We need to finalize delegation defaults for the SDK and the console display. Key points: TTL defaults, refresh window, sampling defaults, and how console shows "attributed actor" vs "origin_principal".
arjun: Console should always show attributed_actor in dashboards and only surface origin_principal in audit views (requires extra permission). Avoid showing origin data in the general usage chart.
michaela: Right. SDK defaults should be conservative: default_ttl 600s, refresh_threshold = min(30s, 5% ttl), jitter +/-10%, sample_origin 0.5% by default.
taylor: SDK will expose hooks for custom sampling and a built-in pseudonymizer (sha256 + per-instance salt). We'll document the salt rotation implications.
emily: For telemetry pipelines: core metrics ingest attributed_actor only. Sampled exporter attaches origin_sha and writes to separate storage. Also ensure PII audit logs are only in a locked bucket with retention 90 days.

infra-bot: Reminder: revocation topic `revocations-high` and `revocations-normal` provisioned. Subscriptions: edge-proxy, internal-gateway, job-runner.

sec-bot: Reminder: policy: `delegation_chain_max=3` and `proof_version=v2` required.

arjun: I'll add console toggle to allow customers to enable origin sampling for their org if they want deeper telemetry. Must be explicit and billable.
michaela: Ok owners confirmed. We'll merge the SDK change and telemetry contract into the RFC repo as an appendix. Ship timeline: end of sprint.

emily: Will draft the privacy appendix and example dashboards.
michaela: Thanks all. If no objections, I'll close this thread in a day and open PRs. :thumbsup:
